scope: Independent original-execution reference of the cold-boot title lifecycle continued past the Title stop (0x12c350 selector-1 return) through title updates, the Start/menu interaction, effect106 (water) creation/binding/removal request, title resource retirement, mode-8 destruction and wrapper frees, stopping at the ENTRY of 0x124548 (mode9/mode10 successor constructor) before its body executes, for the routes restore (Start, confirm default Restore) and newgame (Start, Left, confirm New Game). Unchanged retail SCUS_971.29 under the Play research VM. Research evidence only; not physical PS2 proof; never product input.

play.tree_cleanliness: not verified (git on the Play checkout is outside the isolated worktree)

oracle.retained_copy: local/research/retire-title-original-v1/bin/okage-startup-oracle (the binary that ran every final run)
oracle.mode: --title-retire restore|newgame (implies the --title and RNG --rng-products observations plus the Retire hooks); --title-retire ROUTE --minimal for the control (only 0x1296f8 and 0x124548 entries). Default and --title modes unchanged: see regression.

current_time_audit.note: recomputed when this manifest was written; establishes the files present now, not historical reads

run_time_provenance.note: from the runs themselves (run-meta.json, logs, disc-opens.jsonl with the sha256 of every file the guest opened, as read by the VM at run time)

fixed_settings.pad: ScriptedPad (tools/play-oracle/startup.cpp): neutral sticks (128), buttons set by the observer only while paused at a 0x1296f8 entry, from guest state; applied at the next PadHandler::Update like RecordedPad
fixed_settings.pad_script_restore: submode 10 -> press Start; Start consumed (pressed word & 0x800 at a submode-10 entry) -> release; first submode-0x1e entry (selection 1) -> press Cross (0x1f85dc = 0x40); confirm consumed -> release
fixed_settings.pad_script_newgame: as restore until the first submode-0x1e entry -> press Left (0x1f8604 = 0x8000 sets 0x259970, which decrements the selection; Down sets 0x25996c, which this menu does not read); Left consumed (0x259970 = 1) -> release; selection 0 and 0x259970 = 0 -> press Cross; confirm consumed -> release
fixed_settings.vram_initial_fill: 0x00 (fill00-a/b, control) and 0xff (fillff-a/b), before the first guest instruction
fixed_settings.stop: ENTRY of 0x124548 with parent+0x4c = 10 (restore) / 9 (newgame); VM paused there
fixed_settings.checkpoints: title-constructed (0x12c350 selector-1 return = the Title stop), first-update (entry of the first 0x1296f8), stable-menu (the 0x1296f8 entry whose pressed word carries the consumed Start), removal-request (entry of 0x103640 for the water slot from 0x1296f8), resource-retirement (entry of 0x12c8d8 = after the title resource child 0x101058 returned, before the mode-8 destructor body), successor-entry (entry of 0x124548)

commands: sh <evidence>/regress-as-executed.sh   # one --title and one default-mode run of the same binary, fill 00, under the lock
evidence_dir: local/research/retire-title-original-v1 (read-only after capture; trials/ and bin-trial*/ retained development runs of earlier observer builds, not used by the analysis)

pending_at_stop.effect106_note: flags 0x200 = reclaim pending: 0x102218 frees the job on its next service; the title resource child that ran 0x102218 (0x100f90) is retired, so no service has run since; the job still names the retired hanten handle
pending_at_stop.theme_note: 0x12dd50(1) at 0x12c8d8 set [request 1, stream 1, countdown 0x80]; the countdown has advanced to the value shown; stream destruction has not happened (deferred audio tail)

texture allocation or upload after the Title stop

limitations: Play research backend, Debug build; not a physical PS2 proof. Play tree cleanliness not verified.
Vblank numbers are observer-dependent (hooked successor entry vb 1036 restore / 1039 newgame vs 1013 in the minimal restore control); title-update ordinals, pad words and resource state are not.
The null renderer rasterises nothing: draw-written nibbles are ledger classifications (conservative rectangles).

Checkpoint VRAM is read after submitting the processed GS register writes and waiting for the GS thread; the last host-to-local transfer record stays open in the ledger (complete: received == expected).

The pad script is state-driven: Start is pressed at the first accepting title update, so the title fade-in has barely begun at stable-menu; idle title behaviour (attract timeout 1500 updates) is not exercised.
ee-ram snapshots are the first 32 MiB of EE RAM only and only at the stop.
